function.description: The 'what just graduated' feed: recently graduated (AVAILABLE) Virtuals agent tokens on ONE chain (base, solana, robinhood, or ethereum), newest first by graduation time. Use this when the user asks what just graduated or wants to catch a fresh graduation before buying, because a graduation is exactly when the anti-sniper buy tax is at its worst. Returns `agents` alongside chain, matched, totalOnChain, count, `window` and a `windowNote`; each row carries the same fields virtuals__agents_discover returns, including the live antiSniper block (windowActive, remainingSeconds, estBuyTaxPct) - never buy while windowActive is true. WINDOWED the same way: up to 5 pages of pageSize rows from page, with the windowNote naming the exact slice searched and the page to continue from, so an empty result is a statement about that window and never about the chain. Continuation is the same prose-plus-numbers pair, not a cursor: `window` carries firstPage, lastPage, pagesFetched, pageSize, rowsScanned, total and `exhausted`, and `windowNote` says it in words. `exhausted: true` is the only end-of-list signal; otherwise call again with page set to window.lastPage + 1. Out-of-range limit, page or pageSize is REJECTED by name, not clamped. Read-only.
function.name: virtuals__graduations_list

chain.description: REQUIRED. The one chain to list - Virtuals indexes exactly four: base, solana, robinhood, ethereum. Chain slug/alias, or the numeric chain id `TokenFind` returns (e.g. `base` or `8453`).

limit.description: Max graduations to return (default 20, max 100). Out of range is rejected, not clamped.

page.description: 1-based FIRST provider page of the window (default 1). The reply's windowNote names the next page to continue from.

pageSize.description: Rows fetched per provider page (default 100, max 200). Up to 5 pages are scanned per call.
